name: d1_pow2
description: Stockham autosort DIF: blocked split-complex radix-8 engine at L>=128 (zero-shuffle middle stages, conversion fused into the stride-1 stage; at 4096 the two middle stages fuse into one L1-tiled radix-64 pass), in-register AoS codelets at L=32/64, NT final stores when the batch working set exceeds the scoring node's L3; chains: across-batch SoA groups of 8 (L<=2048, from d1_batchlane) or per-transform blocking, with a 2-Newton rsqrt/rcp map fused into the final stage in split form
